title: Abyss Echo
description: An echo from the abyss reverberates through the empty space — sounds that haven't been made yet, words spoken in futures that may never come to pass. The echoes coalesce into visible ripples in the air, each one carrying a trace of the dimensional boundary it crossed. Listening too long brings a strange clarity, as if the abyss is trying to teach you something.

choices.label: Capture the dimensional essence
choices.description: Trap the condensed echoes into a vessel, distilling raw dimensional essence from future-sound.

outcomes.text: The echoes compress into shimmering droplets that solidify in your hands. Pure dimensional essence — the distilled memory of boundaries crossed.
You catch most of the essence, but a rogue echo slips through your barrier and shrieks through your mind. The harvest is slim.
The echoes resist containment and lash back with psychic force. You salvage only scraps of residue from the attempt.

choices.label: Listen for guidance
choices.description: Let the abyss's strange wisdom wash over the party, mending wounds with impossible knowledge.

outcomes.text: The echoes carry whispers of healing — memories of wholeness from timelines where you were never hurt. Wounds close as if they never existed.
The wisdom is soothing but incomplete. Some wounds ease while the deeper echoes leave a tingling numbness.
The abyss speaks too loudly. Forbidden knowledge hammers into your skulls, leaving everyone dazed and bleeding from their ears.

choices.label: Move on
choices.description: The echoes are growing louder. Best not to hear what comes next.

outcomes.text: You press your hands over your ears and hurry past. The echoes fade reluctantly, as if disappointed to lose their audience.
